title: LITMUS: Benchmarking Behavioral Jailbreaks of LLM Agents in Real OS Environments
abstract: arXiv:2605.10779v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of LLM-based autonomous agents in real operating system environments introduces a new category of safety risk beyond content safety: behavior jailbreak, where an adversary induces an agent to execute dangerous OS-level operations with irreversible consequences. Existing benchmarks either evaluate safety at the semantic layer alone, missing physical-layer harms, or fail to isolate test cases, letting earlier runs contaminate later ones. We present LITMUS (LLM-agents In-OS Testing for Measuring Unsafe Subversion), a benchmark addressing both gaps via a semantic-physical dual verification mechanism and OS-level state rollback. LITMUS comprises 819 high-risk test cases organized into one harmful seed subset and six attack-extended subsets covering three adversarial paradigms (jailbreak speaking, skill injection, and entity wrapping), plus a fully automated multi-agent evaluation framework judging behavior at

translated_title: LITMUS：在真实操作系统环境中对LLM智能体行为越狱的基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的自主智能体在真实操作系统环境中的快速普及，带来了超越内容安全的新一类安全风险：行为越狱，即攻击者诱导智能体执行具有不可逆后果的危险操作系统级操作。现有基准要么仅在语义层评估安全性而遗漏物理层危害，要么无法隔离测试用例，致使先前的运行污染后续运行。我们提出了LITMUS（LLM智能体操作系统内不安全颠覆测试基准），通过语义-物理双重验证机制和操作系统级状态回滚来弥补这两个缺陷。LITMUS包含819个高风险测试用例，组织为一个有害种子子集和六个攻击扩展子集，涵盖三种对抗范式（越狱话语、技能注入和实体包裹），并配备一个全自动化多智能体评估框架来判定行为（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出LITMUS基准，通过语义-物理双重验证和操作系统级状态回滚机制，在真实OS环境中系统评估LLM智能体的行为越狱风险，涵盖819个高风险测试用例和全自动化多智能体评估框架。
en_tdlr: LITMUS is a benchmark for evaluating behavioral jailbreaks of LLM agents in real OS environments, featuring 819 high-risk test cases, semantic-physical dual verification, OS-level state rollback, and a fully automated multi-agent evaluation framework.
